jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

**Machine Learning Engineer**
=============================

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our ML team at EvenUp. You'll develop and deploy models that power Piai, our proprietary claims-intelligence platform, with a focus on machine learning, natural-language processing, and generative AI.

Working alongside senior ML engineers, data scientists, and legal subject-matter experts, you'll turn raw legal and medical data into production-ready models that directly improve outcomes for personal-injury clients.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Explore, implement, and benchmark ML, NLP, and generative AI methods - including LLM fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, and document understanding.
* Clean, annotate, and transform structured and unstructured case data, and build reusable datasets and data loaders.
* Design experiments, run A/B tests, analyze results, and communicate findings to product and engineering teams.
* Help integrate models into our production systems, partnering with ML platform engineers on testing, monitoring, and scaling.
* Pair with product managers, legal analysts, and software engineers to translate real problems into ML solutions and measurable improvements.
* Stay current with research in LLMs, representation learning, and prompt engineering, and share what you learn with the team.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.
* Solid grounding in ML fundamentals - supervised and unsupervised learning, evaluation metrics, overfitting and regularization.
* Hands-on experience with NLP or generative AI techniques - transformers, embeddings, sequence-to-sequence models, or LLMs.
* Proficiency in Python and ML/NLP libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or spaCy.
* Familiarity with SQL and basic data engineering concepts - ETL, versioned datasets, notebooks.
* Strong analytical thinking, clear communication, and eagerness to learn and iterate quickly in a fast-moving startup.
* Ability to work hybrid (3 days your choice) in our San Francisco or Toronto, Canada office.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP).
* Experience with experiment-tracking tools (Weights & Biases, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, MLflow).
* Familiarity with containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience in a high-growth startup environment.

**Benefits & Perks:**

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:

* Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
* Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
* Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
* 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
* A home office stipend.
* 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
* Paid parental leave.
* A local in-person meet-up program.
* Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.

*(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)*

***Notice to Candidates:***

*To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our* *careers page**.*

*Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.*

*EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

Compensation Range: $130K - $205K

jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**
==============

Lantern is building the AI-native operating system for the $9T wholesale distribution industry. Billions of dollars sit tied up in stock, yet most distributors still buy on gut feel and spreadsheets. We partner with leading distributors to deliver precise, AI-powered purchasing recommendations that drive 30% leaner inventory, 10% higher sales, and 20+ hours saved per week per user. We've gone from $0 to $5M ARR in 8 months, raised $7M from top VCs, and are hitting hypergrowth.

**THE ROLE**
============

We're hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to scale the core ML platform behind our product: the production systems that ingest operational data, train models, and generate recommendations. The central challenge is making these workflows scalable, repeatable, observable, and easy to operate across hundreds of customers. You'll own the platform end to end, from data ingestion through training pipelines to inference and monitoring in production. It's a high-ownership role on a small team, working directly with our CTO to ship systems every customer relies on.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
==================

* Own and scale the ML and data pipelines that power Lantern's customer recommendations.
* Build reusable infrastructure for data ingestion, feature generation, model training, validation, and output.
* Improve pipeline performance, reliability, and observability as Lantern scales across more customers.
* Build systems that catch data-quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected outputs before they reach customers.
* Turn customer-specific workflows into repeatable, configuration-driven systems, and help shape the platform architecture.

**WHAT YOU BRING**
==================

* 4–6 years as an ML or Software Engineer building ML systems in production.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and clean, maintainable, production-grade code.
* Experience building and scaling ML training and inference pipelines, ideally multi-tenant or per-customer.
* Hands-on with Python, cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), and orchestration (Airflow, Kubeflow, or similar).
* Comfort with messy, real-world data.
* BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field.

**NICE TO HAVE**
================

* Supply chain, logistics, demand forecasting, or operations-adjacent experience.
* Time-series forecasting frameworks and traditional ML tools (XGBoost, LightGBM, scikit-learn).
* Prior early-stage startup experience where you wore multiple hats.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET**
===================

* A founding-era, high-impact role at a hyper growth startup.
* Own the ML platform that drives customer P&L on every account.
* Make a massive positive impact across our entire supply chain and economy.
* Competitive compensation: ~$200K base + meaningful equity.
* An office in San Francisco with a tight-knit founding team.

**WHAT WE VALUE**
=================

We hire operators who own outcomes, combining sharp judgment with pragmatic execution and a willingness to do the unglamorous work. Hard work, humility, customer obsession, and pride in a job well done: the values our customers live by, and the values we hire for.

Compensation Range: $200K

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**AI Platform Engineer**

HED is hiring an AI Platform Engineer to develop, evaluate, and improve the AI capabilities that support our people and our practice.

**About HED**

We are a team that is full of ideas, experience, creativity, passionate opinions, insatiable curiosity, uncompromising integrity, commitment, and skill. Our culture is about aspiration, embracing change and challenges, listening to (and learning from) each other, encouraging continual learning, and inspiring collective growth. As an inclusive, integrated architecture and engineering practice, we value the diversity of perspectives, experiences, abilities, and expertise that advance both the work we do, and the world we share.

**Position Summary**
====================

At HED, we believe the most powerful solutions emerge when expertise, technology, and human insight come together. As a national integrated architecture and engineering firm, we are advancing how artificial intelligence connects knowledge, improves workflows, and empowers our people to deliver exceptional outcomes.

You will build and optimize production AI solutions, evaluate large language models, improve AI-generated responses, and transform organizational knowledge into secure, accessible, and actionable intelligence.

Working within our Data & AI team, you will own defined technical initiatives and collaborate with developers, data engineers, and business stakeholders. This role offers opportunities to influence technical decisions and grow into broader platform leadership.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

**AI Model Evaluation and Performance**
---------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain model benchmarking, evaluation datasets, testing methods, and performance baselines across production AI applications.
* Evaluate models, prompts, and configurations against response quality, reliability, cost, latency, and risk; document findings and recommend improvements.
* Support preproduction validation of model, prompt, and application changes.

**Context Engineering and AI Optimization**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), retrieval ranking, prompt structures, context management, and caching.
* Measure answer quality, token usage, and operating costs; use results to guide improvements.
* Collaborate with application developers to improve shared AI capabilities and user experiences.

**AI Solution Development and Delivery**
----------------------------------------

* Deliver defined AI use cases from requirements and design through implementation, testing, documentation, adoption, and improvement.
* Help design workflows that capture and organize employee expertise, skills, and competencies for use in AI-powered applications.
* Develop structured data models, skills taxonomies, and knowledge capture workflows; partner with data engineering to integrate governed datasets.
* Work with business stakeholders to define requirements, success criteria, and practical solutions.

**Data Governance and Responsible AI**
--------------------------------------

* Apply privacy, security, data classification, consent, retention, and access-control requirements to AI solutions and datasets.
* Support dataset quality, lineage, ownership, documentation, and auditability.

**Technical Collaboration and Innovation**
------------------------------------------

* Contribute to architecture discussions, technical reviews, coding standards, automated testing, CI/CD, and code reviews.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly and share technical knowledge with colleagues.
* Evaluate emerging generative AI and agentic technologies for practical application at HED.

**Requirements**
================

* Approximately 4–6+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Hands-on experience developing, deploying, or supporting LLM applications in production.
* Experience implementing AI evaluations, benchmarks, or performance testing.
* Working knowledge of RAG, information retrieval, prompt engineering, and context optimization.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, Git, automated testing, and modern software development practices.
* Experience with cloud applications, APIs, and data integration workflows.
* Understanding of enterprise data governance, privacy, and security.
* Ability to independently deliver complex technical assignments and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, or comparable AI platforms.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, or similar platforms.
* Experience with AI agents, automated workflows, experiment tracking, or multi-model systems.

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to effectively communicate in writing and verbally via phone, video conferencing, and in person.
* Visual acuity to perform responsibilities.

**Work Environment**
====================

We embrace a hybrid model that promotes both autonomy and collaboration, including the freedom to work from home, with regular in-office days to connect with teammates and build culture.

The office is a professional, open-space environment designed for collaborative and independent work.

**Other Duties**
================

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS)
jobs.description:
Meta Robotics Studio builds consumer humanoid robots that bring Meta's AI into the physical world. Our robots run on NVIDIA Jetson Thor with Meta-designed carrier boards and JetPack OS. The Robotics OS team owns everything between the silicon and the robot learning stack. On one chip, our robots run real-time control loops over EtherCAT while large vision-language-action (VLA) models run on the GPU. Our job is to make that computer do both, deterministically, every time it boots.We are hiring a software engineer to help architect and evolve the robotics OS, Meta's build of NVIDIA Jetson Linux for Thor-class robot compute. Working with the team, you will help shape the multi-year technical direction for the robot's operating system, including how we build, release and update it, how it shares one computer between real-time control and AI workloads, and how it scales from a lab of prototypes to a large fleet of production robots. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, controls, and AI engineers across Meta, and with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams as one of several technical points of contact on the platform. This is a hands-on role: when a new board spin won't boot or the control loop misses a deadline, you will be in the kernel log alongside the rest of the team.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS) Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to the technical strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Robotics OS. This covers the board support package (BSP), kernel, OS image, update system, real-time behavior, GPU platform, and fleet tooling across every robot program and compute platform (AGX Thor, IGX Thor, and future NVIDIA silicon)
* Architect the next-generation OS image, including the move to a Yocto / meta-tegra based build. Make it reproducible, hermetic and secure, and make it fast for many engineers to iterate on
* Define and drive the production update strategy: atomic A/B and over-the-air updates, rollback, secure and verified boot, fusing and signing, and factory provisioning, so we can ship to a growing fleet safely
* Shape the platform's real-time architecture. Help define how CPU cores, interrupts, memory and the GPU are divided between control loops at kilohertz rates and large AI models. Set the latency budgets and the measurement infrastructure that proves we meet them
* Collaborate with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams alongside other Meta engineers: share requirements, push fixes upstream, and help plan how we adopt new Jetson Linux / JetPack releases with minimal fork debt
* Partner with electrical, firmware, and mechanical engineers on new compute and carrier-board designs. Weigh in early on SoC configuration, interfaces, power and thermal so boards are easier to bring up and software stays simpler
* Drive bring-up of new boards and modules end to end: boot chain (MB1/MB2, UEFI), BPMP and device tree, pinmux, PCIe/USB/Ethernet, power profiles, and the drivers for robot hardware (EtherCAT, USB-C power delivery, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, sensors, cameras)
* Help set the quality bar for the RT kernel and out-of-tree drivers: kernel configuration, ABI compatibility, and a plan to upstream changes or align with Meta's kernel instead of carrying long-lived patches
* Build the reliability and observability foundation: crash and kernel-log capture, symbolization, boot-time tracing, health telemetry, and fleet triage tooling, so that any robot failure can be diagnosed remotely
* Raise the bar for the engineers around you through design reviews, mentorship, and technical hiring. Grow OS and embedded talent on the team, and help shape on-call and operational practices

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience building and shipping system software for embedded Linux or Android-based products
* Experience architecting and owning an operating system, BSP or platform software stack on a shipped hardware product
* Deep experience with C and Linux kernel internals, including device drivers, device tree, scheduling, interrupts, and memory management
* Proficient in at least one of C++, Rust or Python
* Experience driving new-SoC or new-board bring-up on ARM64, from boot chain through kernel to a production OS
* Experience designing OS image build and release systems, such as Yocto/OpenEmbedded, Buildroot, Debian packaging or AOSP, including the strategy for updates and release management
* Experience debugging hard cross-layer problems spanning hardware, firmware, kernel and user space
* Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams or organizations, including external silicon or hardware vendors

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience growing a platform from prototype to production fleet scale
* A track record of upstream contributions to the Linux kernel, Yocto or related open-source projects
* Experience designing secure boot, verified boot and OTA / A/B update systems for a large device fleet
* Experience with EtherCAT, CAN-FD or other robotics fieldbuses, and with host-to-microcontroller architectures (FreeRTOS, Zephyr)
* GPU platform experience: CUDA, NVML/MIG, TensorRT, or deploying ML inference on edge devices alongside real-time workloads
* Deep hands-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson (Orin / Thor) and Jetson Linux / JetPack, including custom carrier-board bring-up, BCT/BPMP configuration, nvidia-oot, and flashing and mass-production tooling
* Experience with real-time Linux in production (PREEMPT\\_RT, CPU and interrupt isolation, latency analysis) for robotics, automotive, industrial or other safety-critical systems

* Experience with AOSP or other mobile/XR OS platform work: vendor BSP integration, HALs, SELinux, init, OTA, or kernel and vendor upgrade programs

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Intelligent Experiences, MLO
jobs.description:
Do you believe machine learning and AI can change the world? We do. We're the ML Data team within Apple's Intelligent System Experience (ISE) group, and we build the high-quality, high-scale datasets that train the ML features across many Apple products - iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and AirPods. Our work sits behind some of the most visible and personal experiences Apple ships: the wallpaper on your Lock Screen, personalized stickers in iMessage, on-device Genmoji and other Apple Intelligence generative models, and models that recognize faces and build memories of the people you love in Photos.  
  
We're looking for a data scientist who's passionate about ML data and excited to shape the training data behind Apple's next generation of multi-modal features. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings rigorous scientific reasoning and owns problems end-to-end.  
  
Join us and you’ll shape shipping products from your first week, working with petabytes of multi-modal data.  
  
**Description**  
  
You will design and operate the end-to-end data lifecycle that supports training, fine-tuning, and evaluation of large language models and diffusion models. Day to day, that means building distributed pipelines that clean, deduplicate, and enrich massive multi-modal datasets; standing up synthetic data generation pipelines with LLM-based generators, validators, and judges; and engineering agentic workflows - multi-step, tool-using LLM systems - that scale human judgment across far more data than a human team could review directly.","responsibilities":"Design synthetic data generation pipelines - prompt/context engineering, generator/critic loops, diversity and contamination controls and prove the data's impact on model quality through controlled ablations  
  
Engineer agentic workflows (multi-step, tool-using, multi-agent LLM systems) or LLM-based flows (RAG, fine tuning) for curation, annotation, labeling QA, and evaluation, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints where they matter  
  
Define and run quality evaluation for synthetic assets: perceptual and reference-based metrics alongside VLM judges and human preference studies  
  
Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs and diffusion models for specific downstream tasks; run controlled ablations that isolate the contribution of each data intervention  
  
Partner cross-functionally with modeling, product, and privacy/legal teams to translate data tradeoffs into decisions, and identify strategic opportunities to improve our data capabilities  
  
Track and evaluate emerging techniques in data curation and generative AI, and make evidence-based recommendations about what to adopt  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience prompting, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs or vision-language/diffusion models for specific downstream tasks  
  
Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), preference optimization (RLHF, DPO), RAG and retrieval-based data curation  
  
Experience designing, evaluating and productionizing data science algorithms used for data curation, data filtering, deduplication and data down-selection.  
  
Experience designing controlled experiments or ablation studies to understand effect of data on model quality  
  
Experience building agentic or multi-agent, tool-using LLM systems and human-in-the-loop workflows, calibrating judges against human labels, and mitigating failure modes  
  
Strong software engineering skills, with 5+ years in Python, workflow orchestration (Airflow), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP), distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, Ray, or similar) at large scale  
  
Publication record or open-source contributions in NLP, computer vision, or generative AI is a plus  
  
Familiarity with privacy-preserving data techniques (e.g., differential privacy, on-device data constraints) is a plus  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related engineering field  
  
5+ years of hands-on experience applying NLP, computer vision, or multimodal machine learning to production systems, including experience with large-scale data pipelines  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Machine Learning, GeminiApp Personalization, DeepMind
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* 3 years of experience with machine learning algorithms and tools (e.g., TensorFlow), recommender systems, deep learning, or personalization.
3 years of experience with software development in either of these programming languages: Python or C++.  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission-driven team.

We are the Gemini App team at Google DeepMind, building Google's next-generation AI assistant. Stay at the forefront of innovation with Gemini, which features native multimodality, an expansive context window of up to 2 million tokens, and excellent performance. Our mission is to empower billions of people by providing deeply personalized and helpful products. In this role, you will help build a personal AI assistant tailored to the unique interests, passions, and curiosities of every individual.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, prototype, and build robust, scalable, user-facing personalization features on the full Gemini App stack.
* Perform relevant data analysis of user feedback, logs, and evaluation tasks to identify personalization-related quality issues and opportunities.
* Propose and implement targeted quality improvements via fine-tuning or prompting.

jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA, the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator, is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, deployed in production across Meta's data centers and expanding workload coverage from ranking and recommendation to generative AI. The MTIA Software team is part of the AI & Compute Foundation organization. Because the hardware is ours, the software is ours too: we build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply: compiler and toolchain, runtime, kernel libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration, co-designed with the silicon teams generation over generation.The GenAI Frameworks org owns the layer where a model meets the machine. We take frontier models, including large language, multimodal and diffusion models, and make them run efficiently on MTIA. Our work determines how fast those models respond, how much context they can afford to hold, how many of them a given amount of silicon can serve, and how quickly a newly released model can be running and trusted in production.We are hiring a Software Engineer to own a key area of GenAI inference on MTIA, spanning serving frameworks, distributed inference, graph-mode execution and compilation, and core PyTorch integration. This is a domain-expert role: you will set technical direction for your area, drive ambiguous multi-quarter programs across team boundaries, and own the quality bar for accuracy, stability, performance, and test coverage on custom silicon.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Fleet Orchestration Algorithms
jobs.description:
The Core Data Science team builds the products and data assets that let teams across Zoox measure and improve the autonomy and operational performance of our fleet. In this role, you'll develop the algorithms that run our robotaxi fleet: matching vehicles to riders and other missions, staging vehicles where and when they're needed, routing, and pricing.

You'll also model what goes into those decisions: rider demand, the value of the data our R&D fleet collects, servicing needs, and business inputs like events and policies. You'll be the optimization generalist on the team, working alongside specialists in marketplace economics, forecasting, and autonomy, and you'll see your algorithms run on a real autonomous fleet. You’ll join a diverse, experienced team with rapidly growing scope while working with one of the industry’s most valuable autonomous vehicle datasets.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Design, prototype, and help deploy algorithms for vehicle assignment, staging, routing, and pricing
* Model the inputs to orchestration (rider demand, data-collection value, servicing needs, events, and policies) as objectives and constraints
* Work with specialists in marketplace economics, forecasting, and autonomy to turn their models into decisions the fleet acts on
* Measure impact on revenue, utilization, and rider experience through simulation, offline evaluation, and online experiments
* Contribute to how we evaluate and roll out orchestration improvements

### **Qualifications**

* PhD or MS with 2+ years of relevant industry or research experience, in operations research, robotics, controls, transportation, computer science, applied math, or a related field
* Deep expertise in at least one of: combinatorial/integer optimization, stochastic optimization or control, reinforcement learning/approximate DP, network flows, or marketplace/demand modeling, plus the curiosity to work across the rest
* Strong coding skills in Python, C++, or Rust; you write clean, tested, version-controlled code
* Ability to turn ambiguous real-world problems into well-defined models and explain the tradeoffs to non-specialists
* Good communication and collaboration skills

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Internship or research experience in ride-hailing, delivery, logistics, or AV fleets (dispatch, routing, rebalancing, pricing)
* Algorithms deployed in production or used on real operational data
* Publications in operations research, transportation, or robotics venues

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

**About Zoox**

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

**Accommodations**

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

***A Final Note:***

*You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.*

jobs.description:
Data Science - San Francisco

**About the role**

We’re looking for a product data scientist to help OpenAI create more value and drive sustainable growth for young people, families, and learners. You’ll drive product data science across under-18 audiences, emerging opportunities for children under 13, family experiences, and learning and education more broadly.

You’ll help decide where we should invest, what we should build, and how we’ll know it is working. This means understanding distinct audience needs, identifying promising use cases, and turning evidence into a clear product strategy. Your work will connect discovery and early product development with adoption, retention, and sustained user value.

You’ll partner across Chat Product, Growth, Foundations, SafeSys, and other teams, working closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers. **The role focuses and owns product value and growth while dedicated teams own policy and safety.**

**In this role, you will:**

* **Shape strategy and prioritize opportunities.** Size unmet needs and growth opportunities across audiences, use cases, and product experiences. Help teams choose where to invest and sequence work based on expected user value, reach, evidence, and effort.
* **Define what value and success mean.** Develop an audience-specific measurement framework spanning activation, task success, learning progress, satisfaction, and durable retention. Connect these measures to product goals and assess whether repeat use reflects meaningful benefit.
* **Understand users and growth drivers.** Analyze journeys, funnels, and cohorts to uncover where people find value, where they struggle, and what helps them return. Combine behavioral data with surveys and user research to explain differences across ages, family roles, and learning contexts.
* **Measure what changes actually cause.** Design experiments and holdouts to evaluate product and model changes. Apply causal methods when randomization is impractical, make assumptions explicit, and account for seasonality, audience composition, and effects that differ across segments.
* **Turn findings into product decisions.** Work with partners from initial hypotheses through launch and iteration. Recommend what to build, change, expand, or stop, explaining expected impact, uncertainty, and tradeoffs. Follow through to determine whether decisions delivered the intended results.
* **Build reliable measurement.** Partner with engineering on instrumentation, dataset quality, and consistent audience definitions. Create reusable analyses and dashboards that make progress visible and let teams answer recurring questions independently.
* **Create alignment across teams.** Bring a coherent view of audience value to work spanning multiple roadmaps. Help partners agree on priorities, success criteria, and the next questions to resolve, even when ownership is distributed and evidence is incomplete.

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**

* A record of influencing product strategy and improving user outcomes through hands-on data science, including work from an ambiguous question to a decision and measurable impact.
* Strong SQL and Python skills, sound statistical judgment, and practical experience with experiments, causal inference, cohort analysis, and measurement design.
* The ability to develop useful definitions of product value, validate imperfect proxies, and distinguish short-term metric movement from lasting improvement.
* Clear communication and strong product judgment. You can make a recommendational authority.
* Comfort setting priorities independently across a broad scope, staying close to users, and moving between strategic questions and detailed analytical work.

**Helpful experience**

Experience with consumer product growth, youth or family products, learning and education, or generative AI would be valuable. We also welcome experience measuring learning outcomes, combining quantitative and qualitative research, or evaluating products whose value emerges over time.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. jobs.title: Datacenter Robotics Engineer, Datacenter Robotic Products & Services
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Within AIS, the DC Robotics team is growing in maturity, so now is the time to join and drive game changing and rapid innovation used by AWS globally. Our designs will fundamentally change the data center, providing operational and financial benefits that are critical to the success of the AWS business and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to be a technical lead driving the innovations being developed and deployed in the next generation data centers.  
  
AWS is seeking a Robotics Engineer to support building systems that operate in our data centers and collect rich sensor data at scale. We're seeking a Generalist Machine Learning Engineer to own the ML that turns robot-collected data — imagery, LiDAR, thermal streams, etc — into useful, reliable outputs. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of reliable performance in production across a broad range of problems — perception, model fine-tuning, evaluation, and the pipelines that feed and serve them. This role closely collaborates with robotics and software engineers so model outputs are usable downstream, and so field data feeds back into better training data and better models.  
  
As Amazon has a global presence, intermittent travel will be necessary and should be expected to be approximately 30% to AWS offices, data centers, suppliers, vendors, and product validation tests. While most travel will be domestic, some international travel may be required.  
  
About the team  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields
* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including shipping ML to production.
* Strong general software engineering and debugging skills, and fluency in Python.
* Hands-on experience owning problems across the full ML stack: data/feature pipelines, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
* Hands-on experience with the AWS ML stack (or equivalent) — Amazon SageMaker AI (training, tuning, endpoints), Amazon Bedrock, S3-based data/feature pipelines, and GPU training on EC2.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
**What we do**  
  
Delphi, Uber's Lever Efficiency team, builds the system Uber uses to recommend how to invest billions of dollars per year across its marketplace supply and demand levers: courier pricing (supply), courier incentives (supply), delivery and service fees (demand), user promotions (demand), etc. Starting with Uber's Delivery Marketplace business, we turn experiment results into a measure of each lever's incremental value in a common currency and publish it in a dashboard that refreshes automatically. We're also building a budget allocation tool that recommends how to move budget between levers. We work day to day with data scientists, product, operations, and finance.
  
  
**Why it matters**  
  
Today each lever spends against its own budget target, even after it starts hitting diminishing returns. A trusted, comparable measure of what each lever returns lets Uber move money to where it does the most good: more reliable deliveries for customers, more earning opportunities for couriers, and more long-term growth for every dollar spent. The hard part is making the numbers trustworthy enough that Operations and Finance leaders act on them. Then the recommendations have to be proven with well-designed experiments. That's the system you'll help build.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience in an engineering related bootcamp
* 2+ years of experience in professional software development experience, developing and deploying systems in production environments
* Proven skills writing efficient, clean code in Go, Java, or Python
* Ability to debug and fix software bugs in a production scale environment
* Experience with software engineering best practices
* Strong grasp of distributed-systems fundamentals: caching, sharding, consensus, fault tolerance, observability, and incident response
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document architectures and algorithms

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced coursework or industry background in statistics, causal inference, or experimental design.
* Direct ownership of analysis workflows (A/B, quasi-experimental, marketplace simulations) at scale.
  + Python, Pandas, PySpark
  + Data Pipelines (e.g. Spark, Scala)
  + Jupyter Notebooks
* Fullstack development experience (BE, FE, Data Pipelines), this project involves a full suite of development surfaces across UI, backend, and data.
* Experience developing internal tooling used by Ops, Engineers, Finance, Scientists, etc.

**What the Candidate Will Do**

* Build and own data pipelines (Spark, Hive, scheduled workflows) that recompute lever-efficiency estimates from experiment and marketplace data every week. Include data-quality checks, freshness alerts and backfills.
* Build backend services and APIs in Go that store and serve efficiency estimates and budget recommendations.
* Ship full-stack features in the web app: interactive dashboards and a budget allocation tool used by Operations, Finance, Product, and Science.
* Work with data scientists to turn notebook prototypes into production code. This includes confidence intervals, corrections for network effects, forecasts, and an optimizer that moves budget between levers within real constraints, such as fixed total spend and capped weekly changes.
* Work with Uber's experimentation platform to run experiments that test budget moves (switchbacks, geo experiments, synthetic control), and automate reading their results into the dashboard.
* Take features from design to launch: write design docs, review code, test, monitor production, and take part in on-call.
Document methodology and system design so partners can trust and reuse the numbers.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Job Duties**

**Platform Development**

* Help design, build, and maintain both the **frontend and backend** of a new internal AI-powered platform — from writing your first feature to seeing it run in production

**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**

Candidates for this role could end up working with a number of our internal products and teams:

***Flow*** is Hadrian’s FactoryOS, our core platform comprised of a variety of applications that model, manage, and automate an extremely complex network of factories.

***Copilot***is our suite of manufacturing automation products which automates or accelerates key processes within the factory including quoting, CAM programming, and CMM programming.

***Factory Automation***develops robotic cells for use in our factories and the software that controls them.

We have a broad set of applications internally. Candidates interested in redefining manufacturing software will have ample opportunity to do so.

*Note: You do not need to have aerospace, defense, or manufacturing experience to excel in this role*

* Scope, architect, implement, and deploy critical applications that will drive revenue and make a positive impact in the world
* Own a product vertical with the opportunity to build a team around yourself over time (if interested)

* Get to build alongside an incredible team of engineers, operators, and the best machinists/CAM programmers in the world
* Be given autonomy and virtually unlimited room to grow

This role is based out of our Los Angeles (Torrance) or San Francisco Bay Area office.

For this role, the target salary range is $220,000 - $320,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

  401k

This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
The Marketplace Fares Team powers global fares for all of Uber - that's all riders, drivers, eaters, new initiatives and technical consumers. Tens of billions of dollars in gross bookings flow through the systems and experiences within our responsibility. Our scope and critical work spans the entire stack - from platform fare calculation for riders and drivers, to data science prediction of trustworthy upfront prices, to compelling mobile fare experiences for our customers. Fares is a backend team with two product-centric tracks (Rider Fares & Driver Fares) and multiple platform-centric tracks (Fares Platform, Intelligence, Experiences, and Solutions). On this team, you'll work closely with product, operations, data science, and engineering teams throughout the company.
  
  
As a backend engineer you will make an impact in the real world using exciting and new technology. You will work on a fast-paced solutions oriented marketplace team, looking to create robust and powerful features that power the critical internal configuration platform for Fares @ Uber. Your ability to work closely with other engineers, product managers, and product operations teams will bring the best experiences possible in an exciting environment.
  
  
**About the Team**  
  
The Marketplace organization at Uber tackles some of the hardest quantitative problems related to improving Uber's realtime marketplace which deeply impact the everyday experiences of our riders and driver partners. The Marketplace teams focus on building technology to achieve market balance (matching the supply of drivers with demand from riders) and optimize the reliability and availability of Uber's trip fulfillment. We are the brain of Uber, tackling the company's most challenging quantitative problems: optimizing Uber's dynamic pricing system; providing real time positioning guidance to drivers; optimizing dispatches of drivers and couriers to incoming requests; matching riders together for UberPool, and many more.
  
  
**What You'll Do**  
  
As a member of the Marketplace Fares team, you will be doing just that: building out and expanding our powerful Fares backend systems to help build features and drive key new product launches at Uber.

* You will be responsible for development of our framework infrastructure to improve our ability to customize our fare configurations for every Uber business and market need.
* You will have a deep understanding of the problems our platform solves for. You will also get to work with many different parts of the company in helping drive projects that impact millions of customers.
* Participate in periodic on-call rotations and be available for critical issues.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a similar field
* Strong coding/debugging abilities with at least one coding language. We primarily work with Go and Python.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of total software development experience as a backend developer
* Proven experience building highly available distributed systems (at Uber scale) and working across multiple backend services
* Experience working on scalable backend systems utilizing a microservices architecture
* High bar for quality as demonstrated by code reviews, documentation, unit and integration testing
Background in payments/fintech engineering  

  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.  
  
For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

jobs.title: Simulation Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We're building safety-enhancing technology for aviation that will save lives. Automated aviation systems will enable a future where air transportation is safer, more convenient and fundamentally transformative to the way goods — and eventually people — move around the planet. We are a team of mission-driven engineers with experience across aerospace, robotics and self-driving cars working to make this future a reality.

As a Simulation Software Engineer, you will work to shape all aspects of our simulation software stack, including framework performance, flight dynamics modeling, hardware emulation, and simulation-based test infrastructure.

**Responsibilities**

In your role as Simulation Software Engineer, you will lead projects to develop a robust, deterministic, and scalable software simulation framework to accelerate testing of safety-critical systems. You'll work closely with stakeholders, including flight software, guidance/navigation/control, and hardware test engineers to expand our simulation system. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Rhoda Platform
jobs.description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help build and maintain the broad software foundation that keeps our robots running. You'll work across the full onboard stack — from networking and communication infrastructure to perception and control integration, data collection pipelines, and the tooling that lets us continue to develop and improve our robots in the field.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain the networking and communication infrastructure that connects onboard robot systems to each other, to the cloud, and to teleoperation and monitoring systems
* Own data collection pipelines that capture sensor, telemetry, and behavioral data from the robot and reliably upload it to cloud storage for model training
* Build and maintain telemetry and observability systems — giving the team real-time visibility into robot health, system state, and field performance
* Develop internal tooling that accelerates robot software development: deployment pipelines, logging infrastructure, debugging tools, and field testing utilities
* Productize the Rhoda Platform to enable efficient integration with vendor robotic hardware platforms
* Support bring-up and field testing of new hardware revisions, debugging issues across the full onboard software stack
* Collaborate closely with ML, perception, and control engineers to ensure onboard systems meet the data quality and reliability requirements of model training and deployment

**What We're Looking For**

* For experienced hires: 2+ years of experience in robotics software engineering, embedded systems, cloud software, or a closely related field; For new graduates: solid educational background in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related fields
* Passion about a fast-moving & collaborate working environment
* Strong software engineering fundamentals in C++, Python, or Rust
* Experience with networking, IPC, and communication protocols for hardware-software systems (e.g., gRPC, DDS, MQTT, WebSockets)
* Familiarity with cloud storage and data upload pipelines (e.g., AWS, GCP, S3, GCS)
* Experience with ROS/ROS2 or similar robotics middleware in production or research contexts
* Ability to debug across the full stack — from driver-level issues to application behavior to failures in a distributed system, on live hardware
* Excellent engineering principles and high standard on work deliverables
* Comfort working directly with physical hardware in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

**Nice to Have (But Not Required)**

* Experience building telemetry and observability systems for embedded or edge platforms
* Familiarity with perception pipelines or control systems and how they interact with the broader robot stack
* Background in streaming systems or low-latency data transport for real-time robot operation
* Experience with over-the-air (OTA) software updates and deployment infrastructure for robot fleets
* Exposure to learned perception or control models and their integration into real-time robot stacks
* Prior work on early-stage hardware programs (prototype or pre-production robots)

**Why This Role**

* Your work is the connective tissue of the robot — the networking, monitoring, data, and tooling infrastructure you build directly determines how fast the team can develop, debug, deploy and improve our robots in the field
* Work across the full onboard stack alongside perception, control, and ML engineers on a platform that is pushing the frontier of what robots can do
* High ownership in a small, fast-moving team where your contributions shape the development velocity and reliability of the next generation of robots

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the RL teams**
----------------------

Our Reinforcement Learning teams lead Anthropic's reinforcement learning research and development, playing a critical role in advancing our AI systems. We've contributed to all Claude models, with significant impacts on the autonomy and coding capabilities of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5. Our work spans several key areas:

* Developing systems that enable models to use computers effectively
* Advancing code generation through reinforcement learning
* Pioneering fundamental RL research for large language models
* Building scalable RL infrastructure and training methodologies
* Enhancing model reasoning capabilities

We collaborate closely with Anthropic's alignment and frontier red teams to ensure our systems are both capable and safe. We partner with the applied production training team to bring research innovations into deployed models, and are dedicated to implementing our research at scale. **About the role**
------------------

We're hiring for the Code RL team within the RL organization. As a Research Engineer, you'll advance our models' ability to design silicon. Hardware design is difficult and unforgiving – exactly the sort of domain we want Claude to excel at.

jobs.description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

As CLEAR continues to expand its identity platform across physical and digital environments, our network of kiosks and connected devices forms the backbone of our member experience. Ensuring these systems stay secure, reliable, and always available is mission-critical, and that's where you come in.

We're looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Hardware Operations and Platform Engineering team. You'll be sitting at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineer and Embedded Systems Integration. You'll be architecting and maintaining the software layer that keeps thousands of Linux-based kiosks online, healthy, and self-healing, effectively operating a distributed server fleet at the edge.

You'll own everything from OS image management to over-the-air (OTA) updates, device observability, and system recovery, while ensuring our biometric kiosks deliver a consistent, frictionless experience to every traveler, every time.

### ***What You Will Do***

* Architect and implement OS-level watchdogs, process monitors, and self-healing mechanisms to ensure devices automatically recover from failures (service restarts, reboots, or rollbacks).
* Manage and enhance our OTA update framework to enable safe, atomic updates via A/B partition swapping and automated rollback when needed.
* Develop and maintain Python-based services that interact with connected peripherals (payment terminals, scanners, sensors) via vendor SDKs and serial interfaces.
* Own and maintain our custom Linux image (via Yocto, Buildroot, bootc, rpm-ostree, etc), managing systemd units, udev rules, and security policies for a locked-down, production-grade environment.
* Build lightweight monitoring agents to stream logs, metrics, and telemetry (connectivity, performance, temperature) to centralized observability systems such as Datadog or Splunk.
* Work closely with software, SRE, and field operations teams to identify pain points and develop scalable solutions that improve reliability and ease of maintenance.

### ***Who You Are***

* 3+ years of hands-on experience administering embedded Linux systems
* Strong proficiency in Python for system automation, service orchestration, and hardware communication.
* Familiarity with A/B update mechanisms (RAUC, Mender, SWUpdate, or custom partition-switching logic).
* Experienced in serial communications (UART, RS-232, USB-serial) and SDK-based hardware integration.
* Deep knowledge of service dependencies, timers, and watchdog configuration.
* Familiarity with network observability and remote device management at fleet scale.
* Committed to operational excellence, focused on designing for resilience, testability, and safe rollback.
* Collaborative, pragmatic, and curious; equally comfortable debugging a kiosk in the field or improving CI/CD for edge devices.

### ***Why You'll Love This Role***

* Massive impact: Your work ensures millions of travelers experience CLEAR's identity platform without disruption.
* Unique technical challenge: Operate and scale a distributed edge infrastructure at the intersection of IoT and reliability engineering.
* End-to-end ownership**:** From OS image to telemetry pipeline, you'll own the full stack of machine reliability.
* Collaborative culture: Deep cross-functional partnership with engineering and operations experts to create frictionless identity experiences.
* Continuous learning: Work on modern Linux, OTA updates, and observability systems at enterprise scale.

Outside of the office, we invest in your well-being and learning & development with stipends and reimbursement programs.

We offer holistic total rewards, including comprehensive healthcare plans, family-building benefits (fertility and adoption/surrogacy support), flexible time off, annual wellness stipend, free OneMedical memberships for you and your dependents, a CLEAR Plus membership, and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. The base compensation range for this role is **$90,000 – $135,000,** depending on levels of skills and experience.

This total compensation will include base salary and new hire equity package (in Restricted Stock Units) for this position at CLEAR. Additionally, this role will be eligible for refresh equity grants as part of our ongoing compensation program. Actual compensation will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, location, education, skills, experience, and performance. All stock based compensation will be subject to the terms and conditions of applicable agreements.

New York 550K Permanent

Our client is an elite proprietary trading firm founded by MIT and Harvard alumni, consistently delivering 40%+ annual returns across equities and futures. Sitting at the intersection of top-tier academia and high-performance trading, it’s one of the most intellectually rigorous environments in the industry.

  
  

Nearly half of the firm’s roughly 40 people hold PhDs from the world’s leading institutions, and that academic depth is matched by cutting-edge execution. They’re now growing across engineering and research to build the next generation of their trading platform and strategies. This is a lean, high-density team where the code you write and the models you build run in production, and your decisions show up directly in PnL.

  
  

**What you’ll do**

*Software Engineers & Quant Developers*

* Build and optimize the computational infrastructure behind core research and portfolio construction
* Work side by side with researchers to turn new ideas into production trading systems
* Design custom software to process large-scale market data in distributed and single-machine environments
* Write high-performance, multi-threaded code using locks and lock-free primitives
  

  

*Machine Learning Engineers*

* Build and scale the pipelines that train, evaluate, and deploy models on large volumes of market data
* Turn research prototypes into fast, reliable models running in live trading
* Optimize training and inference performance, from data loading to GPU and CPU efficiency
* Develop tooling that helps researchers experiment faster and more rigorously
  

  

*Researchers*

* Develop and test predictive signals and models across equities and futures
* Apply statistics, machine learning, and optimization to noisy, real-world market data
* Design rigorous experiments that separate real effects from overfitting
* See your ideas go from hypothesis to live strategy, with clear feedback on what works
  

  

*Across every role*, you’ll own problems end to end with no layers between you and the result.

  
  

**What you bring**

*Software Engineers & Quant Developers*

* Around 3+ years of software development experience, with strong C++ skills, low-level debugging, and resource optimization
* Experience working in large, complex codebases behind critical systems
  

  

*Machine Learning Engineers*

* Around 3+ years building and deploying ML systems in production
* Strong Python skills and experience with a framework such as PyTorch; C++ is a plus
* A solid grasp of ML fundamentals and how to make models fast and robust in practice
  

  

*Researchers*

* A strong background in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, or operations research
* Hands-on experience with statistical modeling or machine learning on real data
* Comfort coding in Python or a similar language to test your own ideas
  

  

*Everyone*

* A genuine love of hard technical problems: performance puzzles, clean abstractions, and understanding systems all the way down
* Intense intellectual curiosity, whether that shows up in mathematics, chess, research, or building things for fun
  

  

**Nice to have**

* A PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field (more common among researchers, though not required)
* Strong results in competitions such as IMO, IPhO, IOI, Putnam, or competitive programming; many on the team have them, but it’s not a requirement
* An exceptional academic or professional track record, wherever you earned it
* Prior experience in trading, finance, or working with market data
  

  

**Why this role**

* Rare talent density: a team of about 30, founded by MIT and Harvard alumni, where nearly half hold PhDs
* Proven performance: a privately funded firm compounding at 40%+ per year
* Direct impact: a flat structure with no middle management, where great work shows up immediately in results
* Exceptional compensation: base salaries up to $550k, with fully guaranteed bonuses bringing total cash to $1.5M or higher.
  

  

Don’t tick every box? Please apply anyway. Outstanding engineers and researchers come from many paths, and we’d rather hear from you than have you rule yourself out.

  
  

Interested? Reply and Goliath Partners will be in touch. The team is small, so openings are limited.

About Pure Earth:

Pure Earth is a growing international nonprofit addressing one of the most urgent yet solvable global health crises: toxic pollution and its profound impacts on human health. We specialize in preventing exposure to lead and other toxins in low- and middle-income countries, embedding solutions into government systems that outlast any single project or grant.

With substantial multi-year funding through the Audacious Project, Bloomberg Philanthropies, Coefficient Giving, and other partners, secured through 2033, Pure Earth is leading one of the largest concentrated efforts ever undertaken to end childhood lead poisoning. We are scaling proven interventions across dozens of countries in Latin America, Africa, and Asia, working in partnership with governments, multilateral organizations, leading philanthropies, and frontline organizations to identify exposure sources, mitigate contamination, and improve policies and regulation.

Pure Earth holds top ratings from Charity Navigator and Candid, and our work has been featured on the TED mainstage and across major news and global health outlets.
