jobs.description:
**About Within**  
  
Tldr on us: **Series B, $91M raised, 7x growth** last year.

Digital Transformation gave rise to a $600B consulting Industry. AI Transformation will be 10x bigger and will be delivered through agents. We built that.

Our AI discovers how work actually happens across every team and application, Structures it into a living Context Graph, and Improves it continuously.

ServiceNow mapped 900+ processes in 9 days. DoorDash captured 3,800+ finance operations in 14 weeks. That's not a project. That's compounding intelligence.

OpenAI, Google, DoorDash, and Stripe use Within to transform how they transform. We shipped GPT-4 document chat within 12 hours of OpenAI's API launch.

We move fast, reward agency, and care deeply about our customers, our team, and our mission.

**AI Backend Engineer @** **Within**
------------------------------------

**Experience:** 1-3 years shipping production code (or exceptional new grads with strong portfolios)  
**Location:** San Francisco / Bay Area (Relocation assistance available)  
**Job Type:** Full-time

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring Backend + Applied AI Engineers to build the core systems that power Within's multimodal agents in real enterprise environments. This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems and applied AI: you'll design and ship backend services that ingest messy real-world data, orchestrate model/agent workflows, enforce enterprise-grade security and deliver reliable outcomes at scale.

You'll work closely with product, design, and other engineers to turn ambitious AI capabilities into production-grade features that Fortune 500 enterprises can depend on. We care deeply about engineering fundamentals (correctness, observability, security, performance) and equally about iteration speed - because in this space, only the teams who ship quality products & features at incredible velocity win.

You'll be paired with senior engineers who'll accelerate your growth, but you'll own real features from day one - we don't believe in extended bench time.

**Note**: We do not require a CS or Engineering degree. We care about your ability to ship, your systems thinking, and evidence of strong execution - whether through production work, open-source contributions, research, or high-quality side projects.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Backend engineer with sharp product judgment** - You design and build services, APIs, data models, and infrastructure that are reliable, observable, secure, and fast. You're building strong instincts for architectural tradeoffs and you actively seek feedback on your design decisions. You optimize for outcomes - developer velocity, latency, correctness, uptime - and not just for elegance in the abstract.
* **Systems thinker** - You're developing the muscle to see around corners. While solving today's stated requirements, you anticipate how services will need to evolve - functionally and non-functionally. You design for the future but build for the present, and you ask good questions about why things are built a certain way and push back when complexity isn't justified.
* **Applied AI builder who ships to production** - You're energized by LLMs, multimodal agents, orchestration protocols, and the messy work of making the entire AI stack reliable. You think instinctively in terms of evals, model regression tests, traceability, and exception handling. You've built at least one meaningful AI-powered project - whether production, open-source, or a serious side project - and you understand the gap between a working demo and a reliable system.
* **AI-native developer across the entire SDLC** - You wield tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Copilot as extensions of your craft. You are extremely confident to run concurrent agents doing your chores reliably. You use AI to generate technical designs, scaffold APIs, draft schemas, write tests, and build migration plans. You're hungry to master these workflows and are already noticeably faster than peers who haven't embraced AI tooling.
* **Ship with velocity and craft** - You find the shortest path to get features into users' hands while obsessing over the details that create trust. You can calibrate the tradeoff between speed and tech debt, and you welcome guidance on where the line is. You believe speed and quality aren't opposites - they happen together when you're thoughtful about how you build.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS)
new_jobs.description:
Meta Robotics Studio builds consumer humanoid robots that bring Meta's AI into the physical world. Our robots run on NVIDIA Jetson Thor with Meta-designed carrier boards and JetPack OS. The Robotics OS team owns everything between the silicon and the robot learning stack. On one chip, our robots run real-time control loops over EtherCAT while large vision-language-action (VLA) models run on the GPU. Our job is to make that computer do both, deterministically, every time it boots.We are hiring a software engineer to help architect and evolve the robotics OS, Meta's build of NVIDIA Jetson Linux for Thor-class robot compute. Working with the team, you will help shape the multi-year technical direction for the robot's operating system, including how we build, release and update it, how it shares one computer between real-time control and AI workloads, and how it scales from a lab of prototypes to a large fleet of production robots. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, controls, and AI engineers across Meta, and with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams as one of several technical points of contact on the platform. This is a hands-on role: when a new board spin won't boot or the control loop misses a deadline, you will be in the kernel log alongside the rest of the team.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS) Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to the technical strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Robotics OS. This covers the board support package (BSP), kernel, OS image, update system, real-time behavior, GPU platform, and fleet tooling across every robot program and compute platform (AGX Thor, IGX Thor, and future NVIDIA silicon)
* Architect the next-generation OS image, including the move to a Yocto / meta-tegra based build. Make it reproducible, hermetic and secure, and make it fast for many engineers to iterate on
* Define and drive the production update strategy: atomic A/B and over-the-air updates, rollback, secure and verified boot, fusing and signing, and factory provisioning, so we can ship to a growing fleet safely
* Shape the platform's real-time architecture. Help define how CPU cores, interrupts, memory and the GPU are divided between control loops at kilohertz rates and large AI models. Set the latency budgets and the measurement infrastructure that proves we meet them
* Collaborate with NVIDIA's Jetson engineering teams alongside other Meta engineers: share requirements, push fixes upstream, and help plan how we adopt new Jetson Linux / JetPack releases with minimal fork debt
* Partner with electrical, firmware, and mechanical engineers on new compute and carrier-board designs. Weigh in early on SoC configuration, interfaces, power and thermal so boards are easier to bring up and software stays simpler
* Drive bring-up of new boards and modules end to end: boot chain (MB1/MB2, UEFI), BPMP and device tree, pinmux, PCIe/USB/Ethernet, power profiles, and the drivers for robot hardware (EtherCAT, USB-C power delivery, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, sensors, cameras)
* Help set the quality bar for the RT kernel and out-of-tree drivers: kernel configuration, ABI compatibility, and a plan to upstream changes or align with Meta's kernel instead of carrying long-lived patches
* Build the reliability and observability foundation: crash and kernel-log capture, symbolization, boot-time tracing, health telemetry, and fleet triage tooling, so that any robot failure can be diagnosed remotely
* Raise the bar for the engineers around you through design reviews, mentorship, and technical hiring. Grow OS and embedded talent on the team, and help shape on-call and operational practices

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience building and shipping system software for embedded Linux or Android-based products
* Experience architecting and owning an operating system, BSP or platform software stack on a shipped hardware product

new_jobs.description:
Meta designs and deploys its own AI systems. MTIA, the Meta Training and Inference Accelerator, is Meta's family of in-house AI accelerator ASICs, deployed in production across Meta's data centers and expanding workload coverage from ranking and recommendation to generative AI. The MTIA Software team is part of the AI & Compute Foundation organization. Because the hardware is ours, the software is ours too: we build the entire stack a chip vendor would normally supply: compiler and toolchain, runtime, kernel libraries, developer tooling, and deep PyTorch integration, co-designed with the silicon teams generation over generation.The GenAI Frameworks org owns the layer where a model meets the machine. We take frontier models, including large language, multimodal and diffusion models, and make them run efficiently on MTIA. Our work determines how fast those models respond, how much context they can afford to hold, how many of them a given amount of silicon can serve, and how quickly a newly released model can be running and trusted in production.We are hiring a Software Engineer to own a key area of GenAI inference on MTIA, spanning serving frameworks, distributed inference, graph-mode execution and compilation, and core PyTorch integration. Product Policy - San Francisco

**About the Team**

The Product Policy research team studies how people use and experience AI product, policy, and safety decisions. We partner with researchers, data scientists, engineers, and cross-functional teams to understand AI’s effects on people’s lives, including well-being, youth experiences, and social and emotional use.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Applied Scientist to help design, execute, and analyze large-scale longitudinal research on AI use and well-being. You’ll work closely with research leads to translate scientific questions into rigorous studies, combining survey responses with behavioral data to understand how people’s experiences with AI evolve over time.

This is a hands-on role spanning applied analysis, research methods, and study execution. You’ll build reproducible analytical workflows, assess data quality and representativeness, and help establish reliable infrastructure for ongoing panel research. Your work will support research involving teens and adults, including studies of AI companionship, and help turn findings into useful evidence for product, policy, and safety partners.

**In this role, you will:**

* Partner with research leads to develop study designs, survey measures, and analysis plans for longitudinal research on AI use and well-being.
* Conduct statistical analyses of survey and behavioral dataage patterns, and sample representativeness.
* Prepare and validate analysis-ready datasets, implement analysis plans, and produce clear summaries and visualizations using reproducible workflows.
* Develop quality checks across survey programming, fieldwork, data delivery, and repeated study waves to identify inconsistencies and improve research reliability.
* Own day-to-day study execution, coordinating timelines, vendors, and cross-functional dependencies to deliver high-quality research on schedule.
* Collaborate with data engineering and privacy partners on responsible account linkage, data flows, logging, and retention.
* Support human-subjects research review, including Institutional Review Board (IRB) documentation, protocol amendments, and consent and assent processes.
* Maintain clear documentation of methods, measures, assumptions, and protocol changes, and contribute analysis and methodological materials for research readouts, publications, and peer review.
* Communicate findings, limitations, and practical recommendations to technical and nontechnical partners, and build reusable tools and processes that improve future studies.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have experience conducting applied quantitative research in social science, behavioral science, human-computer interaction, statistics, or a related field.
* Bring strong foundations in survey research and statistical analysis, with experience working on panel studies, longitudinal datasets, or human-subjects research.
* Are comfortable using SQL and Python or R to prepare data, implement analyses, validate results, and create visualizations.
* Understand how recruitment, missing data, participant attrition, and measurement choices can affect the interpretation and generalizability of findings.
* Can move between analytical work and practical execution, managing multiple timelines and collaborators while maintaining scientific rigor.
* Communicate clearly.
* Exercise sound judgment when working with sensitive data and research involving minors.
* Enjoy building structure in ambiguous environments and collaborating across disciplines.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience combining survey responses with behavioral or product data.
* Familiarity with preregistration, measure validation, reproducible research, and academic publication or peer-review processes.
* Experience working with research vendorss, or IRB and ethics-review partners.
* Research experience related to AI-human interaction, digital well-being, youth development, or social and emotional uses of technology.

new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
The Marketplace Fares Team powers global fares for all of Uber - that's all riders, drivers, eaters, new initiatives and technical consumers. Tens of billions of dollars in gross bookings flow through the systems and experiences within our responsibility. Our scope and critical work spans the entire stack - from platform fare calculation for riders and drivers, to data science prediction of trustworthy upfront prices, to compelling mobile fare experiences for our customers. Fares is a backend team with two product-centric tracks (Rider Fares & Driver Fares) and multiple platform-centric tracks (Fares Platform, Intelligence, Experiences, and Solutions). On this team, you'll work closely with product, operations, data science, and engineering teams throughout the company.
  
  
As a backend engineer you will make an impact in the real world using exciting and new technology. You will work on a fast-paced solutions oriented marketplace team, looking to create robust and powerful features that power the critical internal configuration platform for Fares @ Uber. Your ability to work closely with other engineers, product managers, and product operations teams will bring the best experiences possible in an exciting environment.
  
  
**About the Team**  
  
The Marketplace organization at Uber tackles some of the hardest quantitative problems related to improving Uber's realtime marketplace which deeply impact the everyday experiences of our riders and driver partners. The Marketplace teams focus on building technology to achieve market balance (matching the supply of drivers with demand from riders) and optimize the reliability and availability of Uber's trip fulfillment. We are the brain of Uber, tackling the company's most challenging quantitative problems: optimizing Uber's dynamic pricing system; providing real time positioning guidance to drivers; optimizing dispatches of drivers and couriers to incoming requests; matching riders together for UberPool, and many more.
  
  
**What You'll Do**  
  
As a member of the Marketplace Fares team, you will be doing just that: building out and expanding our powerful Fares backend systems to help build features and drive key new product launches at Uber.

* You will be responsible for development of our framework infrastructure to improve our ability to customize our fare configurations for every Uber business and market need.
* You will have a deep understanding of the problems our platform solves for. You will also get to work with many different parts of the company in helping drive projects that impact millions of customers.
* Participate in periodic on-call rotations and be available for critical issues.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a similar field
* Strong coding/debugging abilities with at least one coding language. We primarily work with Go and Python.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of total software development experience as a backend developer
* Proven experience building highly available distributed systems (at Uber scale) and working across multiple backend services
* Experience working on scalable backend systems utilizing a microservices architecture
* High bar for quality as demonstrated by code reviews, documentation, unit and integration testing
Background in payments/fintech engineering  

  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.  
  
For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the RL teams**
----------------------

Our Reinforcement Learning teams lead Anthropic's reinforcement learning research and development, playing a critical role in advancing our AI systems. We've contributed to all Claude models, with significant impacts on the autonomy and coding capabilities of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5. Our work spans several key areas:

* Developing systems that enable models to use computers effectively
* Advancing code generation through reinforcement learning
* Pioneering fundamental RL research for large language models
* Building scalable RL infrastructure and training methodologies
* Enhancing model reasoning capabilities

We collaborate closely with Anthropic's alignment and frontier red teams to ensure our systems are both capable and safe. We partner with the applied production training team to bring research innovations into deployed models, and are dedicated to implementing our research at scale. Our Reinforcement Learning teams sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and engineering excellence, with a deep commitment to building high-quality, scalable systems that push the boundaries of what AI can accomplish.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring for the Code RL team within the RL organization. As a Research Engineer, you'll advance our models' ability to design silicon. Hardware design is difficult and unforgiving – exactly the sort of domain we want Claude to excel at.

You'll leverage your chip design expertise and turn it into tasks and signals for models to learn from. Specifically, you will:

* Invent, design, and implement RL environments and evaluations for agentic RTL generation, design (including formal) verification, physical design optimization.
* Work on cross-cutting RL considerations such as EDA-tool latency optimization and proxy rewards.
* Conduct experiments and shape our roadmap.
* Deliver your work into research and production training runs.
* Collaborate with other researchers and engineers across and outside Anthropic.

You may be a good fit if you:

* Have expertise in ASIC or FPGA design: RTL, design verification (UVM, formal methods, coverage-driven), physical design (synthesis, place-and-route, timing closure), PPA optimization, DFT, ECOs.
* Are fluent with industry EDA tools and processes.
* Have taped out chips and have experience going from spec to silicon.
* Know how to balance research exploration with engineering implementation.
* Are passionate about AI's potential and committed to developing safe and beneficial systems.

Strong candidates may also have:

* Experience with reinforcement learning, evaluations or environments.
* Built tooling or automation around chip design flows.
* Worked on ML accelerators or high-performance compute hardware.
* Familiarity with high-level synthesis or architecture simulators.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming our media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to enhance flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world.

A few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

* **Building the future of Disney’s media:** DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
* **Reach & Scale:** The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more.
* **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment & news.

**Job Summary**

The **Cannonball squad** sits within MarTech Tools in Commerce & Identity (Commerce – Acquire). We build internal platforms that power how Disney Streaming markets and publishes to hundreds of millions of unauthenticated visitors across Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, and Star+.

Cannonball is the enterprise CMS and publish engine for marketing landing pages and related experiences. Editors use it to model content, author in a rich entry editor, schedule and bulk-publish, and roll out localized variants globally.

Cannonball sits at the center of a connected MarTech suite:

* **Magic Frame:** Source for incoming assets and templates
* **Royalball:** Editorial content workflow management
* **Nexus / Web Growth:** Delivery pipeline for published end-user experiences
* **Pixelball & Wayback:** Experience validation and historical archiving

Product Marketing, Paid Media, Marketing Design, SEO, Ad Ops, Legal, and Customer Support all depend on this stack to ship campaigns faster with built-in governance. We work in two-week sprints (CNBL), ship from the cnbl/monorepo, and invest heavily in engineering-owned quality, including Playwright E2E, test data infrastructure (TDI), and SonarQube gates on every PR.

**Responsibilities and Duties of the Role**

As Product Software Engineer I on Cannonball, you will grow by shipping real product with close mentorship from senior engineers. Your day-to-day work typically includes:

**Feature Development:** Build features on the Cannonball web app and supporting services—including entry editor, content models, publishing workflows, localization/locale behavior, and integrations with the broader MarTech ecosystem.

* **UI & API Engineering:** Implement bug fixes and incremental improvements in Vue 3 / TypeScript UI and Node-based APIs, with a strong focus on clarity and maintainability.
* **Automated Testing:** Write unit tests (Vitest), integration tests, and Playwright E2E suites for Tier 1 publish journeys following squad Definition of Done and coverage expectations.
* **Agile Participation:** Participate actively in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, and tech discussions; ask questions early and document learnings.
* **Operational Awareness:** Leverage stage/pre-prod environments and our isolated E2E environment to validate changes prior to production.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with QA governance, sibling squads (Web Growth / Nexus), and internal daily power users.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Solid understanding of JavaScript or TypeScript and core web fundamentals (HTML/CSS, HTTP, REST, browser devtools).
* Coursework, internships, or personal projects demonstrating your ability to implement, test, and debug small features end-to-end.
* Comfort learning within a large codebase and proactively seeking guidance.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills; ability to work effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Vue, React, or another modern SPA framework.
* Familiarity with Git version control, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions or similar).
* Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, or E2E).
* Interest in CMS platforms, content modeling, localization, or marketing technology.

**Required Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field of study, or equivalent work experience
